note: Generic entries only: the engine ships no furniture library. A household's own item types go in its catalog.json (next to rooms/) and each room's catalog.json; later entries win. Dimensions in meters. w = width (left-right as you face the item's front), d = depth (front-back), h = height. mount 'wall' items snap to walls; z = bottom height. clearance = free space needed on each side to use the item.
